summary: Iteration 8 — validated (a) new public /api/artworks/cache/{artwork_id} endpoint for all 50 seeded masterpieces, (b) Pricing RestorationTeaser before/after widget, (c) Gallery using local cached image URLs. Backend: 57/58 pytest tests passed. Frontend: all data-testid hooks present, Starry Night teaser image loads, 20/20 gallery images load via /api/artworks/cache/ with object-contain + aspect-[3/4] + bg-[#1a1a18].

minor.issue: Cache-Control header sent by backend ('public, max-age=31536000, immutable') is OVERRIDDEN by the Kubernetes ingress/preview proxy to 'no-store, no-cache, must-revalidate' when accessed via the public preview URL. Verified locally: curl to http://localhost:8001 returns a JPEG body but the proxy replaces response headers. Backend code at /app/backend/server.py:1617-1621 is correct; the ingress is the culprit. This will not affect functional behavior (images still load), only browser-side long-term caching. Likely harmless in preview environment but should be confirmed on production deployment where ingress config may differ.

action_items: (Optional, low priority) Verify Cache-Control: public, max-age=31536000, immutable is preserved on production ingress. In preview environment, ingress rewrites it to no-store. The upstream backend response is correct — this is a proxy-layer behavior, not a code bug.

Gallery cards use aspect-[3/4] + bg-[#1a1a18] + object-contain as required; images are referrer-no-referrer and lazy-loaded — good.

The only failing assertion is Cache-Control header — the backend emits it correctly but the preview ingress rewrites to no-store. rca of the issue: Cache-Control header override: FastAPI FileResponse sets correct headers (verified via localhost:8001). The Kubernetes ingress controller / preview proxy injects `Cache-Control: no-store, no-cache, must-revalidate` on all responses before returning to client. This is a known-safe default for preview environments. No code change required unless production deployment also exhibits the same override.
